   266	 * @der: DER data to decode containing the OCTET SEQUENCE.
   267	 * @der_len: The length of the @der data to decode.
   268	 * @ret_len: Output variable containing the encoded length of the DER data.

   273	 * Extract an OCTET SEQUENCE from DER data. Note that this function
   274	 * expects the DER data past the tag field, i.e., the length and
   275	 * content octets.
   276	 *
   277	 * Returns: Returns %ASN1_SUCCESS on success, or an error.
   278	 **/
   279	int
   280	asn1_get_octet_der (const unsigned char *der, int der_len,
   281	                    int *ret_len, unsigned char *str, int str_size,
   282	                    int *str_len)
   283	{
   284	  int len_len = 0;
   285	
   286	  if (der_len <= 0)
   287	    return ASN1_GENERIC_ERROR;
   288	
   289	  *str_len = asn1_get_length_der (der, der_len, &len_len);
   290	
   291	  if (*str_len < 0)
   292	    return ASN1_DER_ERROR;
   293	
   294	  *ret_len = *str_len + len_len;
   295	  if (str_size >= *str_len)
   296	    {
   297	      if (*str_len > 0 && str != NULL)
   298	        memcpy (str, der + len_len, *str_len);
   299	    }
   300	  else
   301	    {
   302	      return ASN1_MEM_ERROR;
   303	    }
   304	
   305	  return ASN1_SUCCESS;
   306	}
